name: Cleft of Shadow
summary: Rogues, warlocks, and their teachers gather in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. There they practice their arts beneath the Horde's watch.

sections.title: A Subterranean Sanctuary
sections.body: Beneath Orgrimmar, the Cleft shelters rogues of the Shadowswift Brotherhood and warlocks of the Darkfire Enclave. Thrall's Horde honors shamanism and strength of arms, yet its leaders leave room for subtler arts. So practitioners of poison and fel energy work apart from the valley districts, beneath Orgrimmar's watch.

sections.title: A Dangerous Threshold
sections.body: At the cavern's lowest point, a passage leads into Ragefire Chasm. Volcanic caves honeycomb the ground below Orgrimmar. Their danger draws defenders and sinister cultists to the cavern's edge.

faq.q: Why are warlocks and rogues kept underground here?
faq.answer: Thrall seeks to unite the Horde through honorable shamanic and warrior traditions. Many orcs distrust the arts of rogues and warlocks, so the caverns keep their dangerous fel workings and illicit practices contained and watched.

faq.q: What major trainers and services can be found in the Cleft of Shadow?
aliases: who is in cleft of shadow
faq.answer: Rogue and warlock trainers work in the Cleft, alongside poison suppliers, reagent vendors, and merchants selling wands and staffs.

faq.q: What is the entrance at the bottom of the cavern?
faq.answer: The opening leads to Ragefire Chasm, a dangerous network of lava tubes beneath Orgrimmar. Troggs, searing elementals, and rogue cultists infest its depths.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you can summon demons and bind fel energy in the Darkfire Enclave beneath Orgrimmar. There, you are away from the immediate wrath of shaman and warriors.
As a rogue, you find the Shadowswift Brotherhood, poison merchants, and lockpickers in this dark recess. It is the Horde's main gathering place for stealth operatives.
